note: STARTER calibration shipped with the repo. Seed it to <RECORD_DIR>/../calibration.json so a fresh unit starts on a tight bee-sized blob-area window [62, 554] instead of the wide-open code defaults [20, 5000]. Derived by running bee_tracking.pt over the committed short_videos samples (union of two clips, 39 bee blobs) at lores 640x480. The daily beemonitor-calibrate job overwrites this with values learned from THIS unit's own snippets, so it self-tunes to the actual camera framing.
